crypto_keylength_justification: The documented enforced local/offline configuration eliminates unmanaged SDK TLS via trusted loopback services and pre-staged models. Its owned MCP/corpus/forum HTTPS contexts check exact RSA2048, EC224, DSA2048/224 or supported Ed25519/Ed448 chain keys including trust roots; TLS1.2+ and normal trust/hostname checks remain required. The separate release CLI profile disables smaller keys. Default compatibility SDK configurations have narrower guarantees. https://github.com/4alvit/energy-data-rag-pipeline/blob/main/docs/tls-policy.md
crypto_working_justification: Supported Python/OpenSSL defaults use current TLS1.2+ with 128-bit-or-stronger symmetric encryption and ephemeral exchange. No broken-cipher override is introduced.
